text:
jamie: Hi team — quick benefits/payroll question. I started Monday and still haven’t received my health insurance card. Is coverage retroactive to my start date? Also I have a receipt for work glasses — who do I submit that to for reimbursement? Thanks!

Marta (People Ops): Hey @jamie welcome! Health cards are issued by our benefits vendor and usually arrive in 7–10 business days. Coverage is retroactive to your start date. If you need proof sooner I can generate a temporary proof-of-coverage PDF we can email to your provider — DM me your employee ID.

jin: For glasses reimbursement submit an expense in Expensify under category `Vision Reimbursement` and attach the receipt + prescription image if available. Put `Vision - New Hire` in the notes and tag @Marta so we can approve quickly. Our typical allowance is up to $150 per 12 months.

PayrollBot: PayrollBot: New hire onboarding checklist updated and benefits links posted — https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/benefits-forms (automated message)

jamie: Thanks! If Marta can generate the PDF that’d be great — is that a one-page letter I can forward to my optometrist? Also I didn’t see a prescription field in Expensify, just attachments.

Marta (People Ops): Yep, the PDF is a one-page proof letter you can forward. I can also send a verifier link if the clinic needs an online lookup. For Expensify just attach the prescription image and mention it in the notes. If you prefer the manual form we have a short claim PDF: `https://redwood.example.com/hr/forms/vision-claim.pdf`

jin: One more note — reimbursements hit payroll on the next normal run after approval. If you want it faster, confirm your bank details in Workday (direct deposit) and mark the expense as priority; we can route under expedited payment if needed.

jamie: I DM’d @Marta my employee ID. Quick calendar Q: Workday shows company holidays as "observed" but my Google calendar doesn’t have them. Do people-ops push calendar invites or should I import something?

Marta (People Ops): We publish the company holiday calendar at the start of each quarter and push invites, but sometimes auto-sync misses. You can import the iCal: `webcal://calendar.redwood.example.com/company-holidays.ics` or let me know and I’ll re-send the invite. :partyparrot:

sam: pinging @Payroll — confirming that `Vision Reimbursement` is the right code and that sub-$150 claims can be expedited if needed.

PayrollBot: PayrollBot: Verified reimbursement code `VISION_REIMB`. Expedited payments processed within 3–5 business days after approval.

jamie: Amazing, thanks everyone — brand new hire relief! :relieved:
